rule: probe verdicts are illustration only; the vocabulary excludes 'verified' by construction

3.domain: zeta zeros on the critical line; off-line grid scan t in [10, 40], sigma in {0.2..0.8} (hardcoded window)
engine_limitations_found: Root-discovery completeness degrades with height at fixed cost: the scan step is hardcoded at 0.05 and the miss rate grows from 0% (T<=100) to 14.5% (T=300, 118/138 isolated). The CLI sample-count argument does not affect discovery, so the deficit is inherent to the engine, not to the invocation.
The OFF_LINE_GRID_SCAN_PASS verdict is scoped to a hardcoded window t in [10, 40] regardless of the requested height; it does not scan the requested range.
3.can_say: at T=60 all 13 roots are isolated on the critical line, calibrated to 1.15e-9, and no off-line zero appears in the scanned window
3.cannot_say: quasi-RH is about every Dirichlet L-function and all heights; the engine checks zeta(s) only, discovery misses zeros at higher T, and the off-line window is [10, 40] only

5.domain: small-coefficient (|m_i| <= 4) integer relations among {1, G, pi, pi^2, log2, zeta3, sqrt2, e}, f64 precision, eps = 1e-11
5.can_say: no small-coefficient integer relation among these constants at f64 precision (a relation would have been a refutation-grade finding)
5.cannot_say: irrationality of Catalan's constant; f64 precision and bounded coefficients exclude only a tiny subspace of possible refutations

13.reason: Ostmann's inverse Goldbach claim quantifies over ALL finite modifications of the primes ('no finite modification is additively decomposable') and over all large integers. The committed goldbach_verifier only certifies the classical finite range [4, 2e6]; no engine enumerates modification classes, so the statement has no finite probe path in the current system.

17.family_title: The irrationality exponent of pi is 2
17.engine: convergent continued fraction of pi (mpmath, high precision)
17.domain: first 2000 partial quotients / convergents of pi
17.can_say: the best rational approximations found up to this depth never beat the reported max exponent; the exponent curve decreases toward 2 as q grows (no anomalous sequence)
17.cannot_say: mu(pi) = 2 exactly; a finite convergent list cannot rule out arbitrarily late exceptions
